questions.question: Mina, now a national aesthetics reference, is invited to an international congress. What message should she carry?
options: Aesthetics is a model of excellence and art
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Aesthetics is a model of excellence and art.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Sami must create a foundation to promote dental aesthetics. What is the main objective?
options: Promote the art of the smile
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting the art of the smile is essential for the future.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Mina must write a reference book on aesthetics. What is the central message?
options: Aesthetics is an art that combines technique and sensitivity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Aesthetics is an art that combines technique and sensitivity.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Aesthetics is evolving, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Aesthetics is evolving, full of opportunities.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a mentoring program in aesthetics. What is the main objective?

questions.question: Sami must manage the succession of his aesthetic expertise. What is the best strategy?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Gradual preparation of transmission is the key to a successful succession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Mina must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
